diff --git a/sphinx/util/rst.py b/sphinx/util/rst.py
index 7a15383..de40ce1 100644
--- a/sphinx/util/rst.py
+++ b/sphinx/util/rst.py
@@ -29,6 +29,11 @@ docinfo_re = re.compile(':\\w+:.*?')
 symbols_re = re.compile(r'([!-\-/:-@\[-`{-~])')  # symbols without dot(0x2e)
 SECTIONING_CHARS = ['=', '-', '~']
 
+# RE for matching a reST section title's overline or underline, e.g.
+# a line of the form ``====`` or ``----``.  Cf. the ``line`` transition
+# pattern used by ``docutils.parsers.rst.states.Body``.
+SECTION_ADORNMENT_RE = re.compile(r'^([!-/:-@\[-`{-~])\1*\s*$')
+
 # width of characters
 WIDECHARS: dict[str, str] = defaultdict(lambda: "WF")  # WF: Wide + Full-width
 WIDECHARS["ja"] = "WFA"  # In Japanese, Ambiguous characters also have double width
@@ -85,6 +90,16 @@ def prepend_prolog(content: StringList, prolog: str) -> None:
             else:
                 break
 
+        if 0 < pos < len(content) and SECTION_ADORNMENT_RE.match(content[pos]):
+            # The would-be docinfo field is actually the title of the
+            # document (its first line happens to also match the
+            # docinfo pattern, e.g. it starts with a role such as
+            # ``:mod:``, and it is immediately followed by a section
+            # title underline).  Do not treat it as docinfo, so the
+            # prolog is not inserted between the title text and its
+            # underline.
+            pos -= 1
+
         if pos > 0:
             # insert a blank line after docinfo
             content.insert(pos, '', '<generated>', 0)
